---
title: "Library - Creatures"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| warning: false

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)

# Connect to database
con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../asset/demonax-test.sqlite")

# Read tables
creatures <- dbReadTable(con, "creatures")
creature_loot <- dbReadTable(con, "creature_loot")
items <- dbReadTable(con, "items")
item_prices <- dbReadTable(con, "item_prices")

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# Get available outfit images to avoid 404s
outfit_files <- list.files("../../asset/img/outfit", pattern = "^[0-9]+\\.png$")
available_outfits <- as.integer(gsub("\\.png$", "", outfit_files))

# Hardcoded currency values for coins
currency_prices <- data.frame(
  item_id = c(3031, 3035, 3043),
  name = c("Gold Coin", "Platinum Coin", "Crystal Coin"),
  currency_price = c(1, 100, 10000)
)

# Calculate average loot value for each creature
creature_avg_values <- creature_loot |>
  left_join(items, by = c("item_id" = "type_id")) |>
  left_join(
    item_prices |>
      filter(mode == "sell") |>
      group_by(item_id) |>
      summarize(price = max(price)),
    by = "item_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(currency_prices |> select(item_id, currency_price), by = "item_id") |>
  mutate(
    final_price = coalesce(currency_price, price, 0),
    avg_amount = (min_amount + max_amount) / 2,
    avg_value = avg_amount * final_price * (chance_percent / 100)
  ) |>
  group_by(creature_id) |>
  summarize(total_avg_value = sum(avg_value, na.rm = TRUE))

# Query creature data with loot values
creature_data <- creatures |>
  left_join(creature_avg_values, by = c("id" = "creature_id")) |>
  mutate(
    total_avg_value = coalesce(total_avg_value, 0),
    avg_value_per_exp = ifelse(experience > 0, total_avg_value / experience, 0),
    avg_value_per_hp = ifelse(hp > 0, total_avg_value / hp, 0),
    # Calculate creature type based on article field
    # Regular creatures have "a" or "an", Bosses have empty string or NULL
    creature_type = if_else(article != "" & !is.na(article), "Regular", "Boss")
  ) |>
  select(name, race, hp, experience, article, creature_type, total_avg_value, avg_value_per_exp, avg_value_per_hp) |>
  arrange(desc(experience), name)

# Create slug and links
creature_data <- creature_data |>
  mutate(
    slug = gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "_", tolower(name)),
    slug = gsub("^_|_$", "", slug),
    # Convert name to sentence case (capitalize first letter of each word)
    display_name = tools::toTitleCase(name),
    # Only show image if outfit file exists, otherwise use placeholder
    Image = ifelse(
      race %in% available_outfits,
      paste0('<img src="../../asset/img/outfit/', race, '.png" width="32" height="32">'),
      '<span style="display:inline-block;width:32px;height:32px;background:#e0e0e0;border-radius:3px;"></span>'
    ),
    Creature = paste0(
      '<a href="/qmd/creatures/',
      slug,
      '.html" style="color: #004294; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;">',
      display_name,
      '</a>'
    ),
    HP = format(hp, big.mark = ","),
    Experience = format(experience, big.mark = ","),
    `Avg. value` = paste0(format(round(total_avg_value), big.mark = ","), " gp"),
    `Avg. value per exp` = paste0(format(round(avg_value_per_exp, 3), nsmall = 3), " gp"),
    `Avg. value per HP` = paste0(format(round(avg_value_per_hp, 3), nsmall = 3), " gp")
  )

# Split into regular and boss creatures
regular_creatures <- creature_data |>
  filter(creature_type == "Regular") |>
  select(Image, Creature, HP, Experience, `Avg. value`, `Avg. value per HP`, `Avg. value per exp`)

boss_creatures <- creature_data |>
  filter(creature_type == "Boss") |>
  select(Image, Creature, HP, Experience, `Avg. value`, `Avg. value per HP`, `Avg. value per exp`)
```
